tasks.label: 🔴 Start Redis Server (Docker Compose)
tasks.command: Write-Host '🔴 Redis Server (Docker Compose)' -ForegroundColor Red; Write-Host '============================================' -ForegroundColor Green; cd infra/docker; Write-Host '🔍 Checking Redis status...' -ForegroundColor Cyan; $status = docker compose ps redis --format json 2>$null | ConvertFrom-Json; if ($status -and $status.State -eq 'running') { Write-Host '✅ Redis already running' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host '🚀 Starting Redis via docker compose...' -ForegroundColor Yellow; docker compose up -d redis; Write-Host '✅ Redis started' -ForegroundColor Green }; Write-Host ''; Write-Host '📋 Connection Details:' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host '   URL: redis://:23233@localhost:6379/0' -ForegroundColor White; Write-Host '   Password: 23233' -ForegroundColor White; Write-Host '   Container: lokifi-redis-dev' -ForegroundColor White; Write-Host ''; Write-Host '💡 To stop: docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml down' -ForegroundColor Gray

tasks.label: 🔧 Start Backend Server
tasks.command: Write-Host '🔧 Backend Server (FastAPI)' -ForegroundColor Blue; Write-Host '============================================' -ForegroundColor Green; cd apps/backend; if (Test-Path venv/Scripts/Activate.ps1) { ./venv/Scripts/Activate.ps1 } else { python -m venv venv; ./venv/Scripts/Activate.ps1; pip install -r requirements.txt }; Write-Host '📡 Starting on http://localhost:8000' -ForegroundColor Cyan; $env:PYTHONPATH=(Get-Location).Path; python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000

tasks.label: 🎨 Start Frontend Server
tasks.command: Write-Host '🎨 Frontend Server (Next.js)' -ForegroundColor Magenta; Write-Host '============================================' -ForegroundColor Green; cd apps/frontend; if (-not (Test-Path node_modules)) { Write-Host '📦 Installing dependencies...' -ForegroundColor Yellow; npm install }; Write-Host '🌐 Starting on http://localhost:3000' -ForegroundColor Cyan; npm run dev

tasks.label: 🗃️ Start PostgreSQL Server (Docker Compose)
tasks.command: Write-Host '🗃️ PostgreSQL Server (Docker Compose)' -ForegroundColor Blue; Write-Host '============================================' -ForegroundColor Green; cd infra/docker; Write-Host '🔍 Checking PostgreSQL status...' -ForegroundColor Cyan; $status = docker compose ps postgres --format json 2>$null | ConvertFrom-Json; if ($status -and $status.State -eq 'running') { Write-Host '✅ PostgreSQL already running' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host '🚀 Starting PostgreSQL via docker compose...' -ForegroundColor Yellow; docker compose up -d postgres; Write-Host '✅ PostgreSQL started' -ForegroundColor Green }; Write-Host ''; Write-Host '📋 Connection Details:' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host '   URL: postgresql://lokifi:lokifi_dev_password@localhost:5432/lokifi_db' -ForegroundColor White; Write-Host '   User: lokifi' -ForegroundColor White; Write-Host '   Password: lokifi_dev_password' -ForegroundColor White; Write-Host '   Database: lokifi_db' -ForegroundColor White; Write-Host '   Container: lokifi-postgres-dev' -ForegroundColor White; Write-Host ''; Write-Host '💡 To stop: docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml down' -ForegroundColor Gray

tasks.label: 📊 Start Coverage Dashboard
tasks.command: Write-Host '📊 Coverage Dashboard' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host '============================================' -ForegroundColor Green; cd apps/frontend; Write-Host '🔄 Checking coverage data...' -ForegroundColor Yellow; if (-not (Test-Path coverage-dashboard/data.json)) { Write-Host '⚠️ No coverage data found. Generating initial coverage...' -ForegroundColor Yellow; npm run test:coverage 2>&1 | Out-Null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { Write-Host '✅ Coverage data generated' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host '⚠️ Tests had issues but continuing...' -ForegroundColor Yellow } } else { Write-Host '✅ Coverage data found' -ForegroundColor Green }; Write-Host ''; Write-Host '🌐 Starting dashboard server on http://localhost:3002' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host '📁 Serving from: coverage-dashboard/' -ForegroundColor Gray; Write-Host ''; Write-Host '💡 Dashboard Features:' -ForegroundColor White; Write-Host '   ✓ Live coverage metrics' -ForegroundColor Gray; Write-Host '   ✓ File-level coverage breakdown' -ForegroundColor Gray; Write-Host '   ✓ Trend analysis and visualizations' -ForegroundColor Gray; Write-Host '   ✓ Auto-refreshes with test runs' -ForegroundColor Gray; Write-Host ''; Write-Host '🔄 To update coverage: npm run test:coverage' -ForegroundColor Gray; Write-Host ''; npx serve coverage-dashboard -l 3002

tasks.label: 🛑 Stop All Servers
tasks.command: Write-Host '🛑 Stopping All Servers' -ForegroundColor Red; Write-Host '============================================' -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host ''; cd infra/docker; Write-Host '� Stopping Redis & PostgreSQL...' -ForegroundColor Yellow; docker compose down; Write-Host '✅ All Docker Compose services stopped' -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host ''; Write-Host '💡 Terminal servers (Backend, Frontend, Dashboard) should be closed manually' -ForegroundColor Gray; Write-Host '   Press Ctrl+C in each terminal or close the terminal windows' -ForegroundColor Gray

tasks.label: 🔄 Restart All Servers
tasks.command: Write-Host '🔄 Restarting All Servers' -ForegroundColor Magenta; Write-Host '============================================' -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host ''; Write-Host '⚠️ MANUAL STEP REQUIRED:' -ForegroundColor Yellow; Write-Host '   1. Close all terminal windows (Backend, Frontend, Dashboard)' -ForegroundColor White; Write-Host '   2. Press Ctrl+C in each terminal OR close the terminal tabs' -ForegroundColor White; Write-Host '   3. Then run the "🚀 Start All Servers" task again' -ForegroundColor White; Write-Host ''; cd infra/docker; Write-Host '🔴 Stopping Docker Compose services...' -ForegroundColor Yellow; docker compose down; Write-Host '✅ Docker Compose services stopped' -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host ''; Write-Host '💡 After closing terminal servers, use:' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host '   Ctrl+Shift+P → Tasks: Run Task → 🚀 Start All Servers' -ForegroundColor Gray
